simulation_assumptions.note: Only these robot hardware, sensor and geometric assumptions are not specified by this PDF.
simulation_assumptions.manual_judging: Illegal target and zone commands prevented; subjective human penalties and real hardware failures are not randomly simulated.
simulation_assumptions.map_fidelity: Chapter 4 dimensioned module footprints and figure4-5 placement; unlabelled joints reconstructed from the plan, not rulebook CAD.
simulation_assumptions.armor_model: finite rectangular robot/base/outpost armor planes with separate solid body and opening-cover occlusion; approximate structure geometry is public

rune_motor.note: Both small and large runes use smoothly varying shaft speed throughout the match; both faces share the same motor. This overrides the manual's constant small-rune speed.

structure_geometry.note: Finite proxies reconstructed from manual figures 4-10/11/32; unlabelled armor centers and motion are simulation assumptions, not rulebook CAD.

pickup_phases.note: Requires actual arm contact, closing, lift and storage. Keep pick_unit true; leaving, destruction, weakness or manual arm control cancels.

simulation_assumptions.physics_engine: rapier3d-f64 0.26.1 enhanced-determinism; 120Hz rigid bodies and ray suspension
simulation_assumptions.robot_hardware: 19 selectable symmetric hardware designs; default six-model lineup preserved; construction bounds enforced
simulation_assumptions.hardware_authority: robot_designs is authoritative; family specs speed/acceleration are retained only for old SDK compatibility

ground_camera_fov_deg.note: Ground FPV follows the physical muzzle direction and chassis pose. Own robot state and referee telemetry remain unrestricted; aerial vision keeps its existing coverage.

source.title: RoboMaster 2027 机甲大师超级对抗赛比赛规则手册

speed_limits.note: Infantry chassis top speed is capped at 5 m/s by the rulebook. A design that asks for more is driven at the cap instead of being fielded faster than the rules allow; the balancing (wheel-legged) infantry reaches it.

adaptations.semi_automatic_sentry_unavailable: no human commander exists in this arena
adaptations.adaptive_armor_excluded: only the radar can select the reinforced centre (5.2); all armor stays default x1

damage.aerial_impact_detection: contact time and surface impulse thresholds are TBD in V1.0.0; see seasons.2027.simulation_assumptions.drone_impact

launcher_unlock.M: max over the game of (opponent base hp - own base hp)
launcher_unlock.N: max over the game of (opponent control - own control)

heavy.launcher_install: at the own workbench; the first referee-detected 42 mm shot completes the installation and counts no heat, speed or damage
heavy.launcher_install_before_unlock: allowed (rules Q&A clarification); the fitted launcher stays unpowered and the opponent shields 42 mm damage until the usage right is unlocked

posture.note: reductions multiply after the other cooling and power buffs; results are integers

control.interrupted_progress: decays at the same rate; paused while both teams activate
control.outpost_destroyed: fully controlled -> same team temporary; temporary -> same team full; a full-control change by destruction rebuilds the outpost for the new owner at 500 HP

fortress.base_drop: base max hp minus the lowest base hp this game

aerial.system: hangar on the own hangar platform plus up to four fully automatic aerial robots

penalties.card_authority: trusted_referee_only; subjective intent is not randomly judged

document_ambiguities.issue: the central highland end ramps are labelled 12 degrees but drawn 0.555 m long for the 100 mm drop (figures 4-27 and 4-35)
document_ambiguities.resolution: plan geometry follows the drawings (10.2 degrees); the stated angle stays in terrain_geometry

document_ambiguities.issue: the text names only the three steps from the trapezoid highland; section B-B of figure 4-17 and figure 4-5 also show a 1200 mm flight of four 200 mm risers from the field on the south side
aerial impact contact time and impulse thresholds are TBD
section A-A gives 200/350/400/300/360 without naming every surface
document_ambiguities.resolution: deck 300, fortress-side band 200, 150 mm rim 400; disclosed reconstruction

document_ambiguities.issue: no 17 mm restriction on base modules while closed is stated
document_ambiguities.resolution: every exposed base module accepts 17 mm, 42 mm and aerial impact; the closed shells still cover the large modules

document_ambiguities.issue: temporary control release conditions name only the absent team
document_ambiguities.resolution: a temporary controller absent for 5 s hands full control to the other team; both present pauses

document_ambiguities.issue: refilling the six energy units during a game is not stated
document_ambiguities.resolution: six units per station per game; assembled or failed units are recovered by the core

source.title: RoboMaster 2027 机甲大师高校系列赛机器人制作规范手册

batteries.ground: DJI or regular dry cells only
batteries.aerial: DJI, dry cells or regular lithium

simulation_overrides.note: 2027 additions and replacements over simulation_assumptions; manual-silent hardware and timing choices.

launcher_install.note: workbench fitting time and tolerance are design choices; the module adds its mass to the chassis

drone_impact.note: manual thresholds are TBD; a valid strike also wears one guard integrity point

drone_projectile_hits.note: projectiles push drones by their momentum; guards stop them from reaching the rotors

rune_motor.note: Small and idle large runes rotate at pi/3 rad/s; active large runes use a*sin(omega*t)+2.090-a, reset on each new large activation; both faces share the shaft.
